name: burdin
description: Burdin language support: the burdin lsp language server, syntax highlighting, and test lenses.

burdin.path.description: The burdin executable: the language server is `<path> lsp`, and the lenses run it. Empty means `burdin` on PATH.

burdin.inlayHints.types.description: Show the inferred type after a `let` name without one.

burdin.inlayHints.parameterNames.description: Show the parameter's name before a positional argument.

burdin.diagnostics.lints.description: Show the diagnostics of `burdin lint` too.

burdin.diagnostics.debounceMs.description: Milliseconds of quiet after an edit before the package is checked again.

burdin.formatting.enabled.description: Format with `burdin fmt` when the editor asks.

burdin.codeLens.enabled.description: Show the run and debug lenses above tests and `main`.
